query:
INSERT INTO purchaseOrderItems (purchaseOrderId, productId, quantity, unitCost, totalCost)
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM purchaseOrders WHERE docNumber = 'TEST-RATEIO-001'),
  id,
  1,
  500.0000,
  500.00
FROM products 
LIMIT 2
